## Objective
Calculate correlations between pathologists (majority) grades and ai-derived features in "pathologist grading set"

### Libraries, functions and directories
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmtest)
library(gridExtra)
library(writexl)
options(scipen = 999)

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"

parse_ai_features_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx//output/parse_ai_features/")

output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx/output/ai_vs_path/"

plot_box_compartments <- function(df, path_feature, ai_feature) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(path_value), !is.na(ai_value))
    
  x_labels <- if (path_feature == "Cellularity" | path_feature == "Cellularity (lamina propria)") {
    c("0" = "Normal", "1" = "Mild", "2"= "Moderate", "3" = "Marked")
  } else if (path_feature == "Mean Size") {
  c("1" = "Small", "2" = "Intermediate", "3" = "Large")
    }else {
    c("0" = "Absent", "1" = "Present")
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(path_value), !is.na(ai_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      layer = factor(layer, levels = c("Villi", "Crypts")),
      compartment = factor(compartment, levels = c("Lamina propria", "Epithelium")),
      path_value = factor(path_value, levels = names(x_labels)))
    
  ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(path_value), y = ai_value)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = cut_width(path_value, 0.2))) +
    facet_grid(compartment ~ layer) +
    labs(
      #title = paste(ai_feature, "vs Pathologist-graded ", path_feature),
      x = paste("Pathologist-graded", path_feature),
      y = ai_feature
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +  # Set size and font
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9)
    ) 
}


plot_box_layers <- function(df, path_feature, ai_feature) {
  
   df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(path_value), !is.na(ai_value)) %>%
     mutate(path_feature = case_when(path_feature== "Patchy infiltration" ~ "patchy lp infiltration",
                                  path_feature == "Clustering" ~ "epithelial clustering",
                                  path_feature == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" ~ "epi-lp ratio",
                                  TRUE ~ path_feature))
    
  x_labels <- if (path_feature == "Cellularity" | path_feature == "Cellularity (lamina propria)")  {
    c("0" = "Normal", "1" = "Mild", "2" = "Moderate", "3" = "Marked")
  } else {
    c("0" = "Absent", "1" = "Present")
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(path_value), !is.na(ai_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      path_value = as.character(path_value),  # avoid factor-to-NA conversion
      path_value = factor(path_value, levels = names(x_labels)),
      layer = factor(layer, levels = c("Villi", "Crypts"))
    )
  
    ai_feature_wrapped <- if (nchar(ai_feature) > 20) {
    if (grepl("\\(", ai_feature)) {
      sub("\\(", "\n(", ai_feature)
    } else if (grepl("-", ai_feature)) {
      sub("-", "\n-", ai_feature)
    } else {
      ai_feature  # don't modify if no good split point
    }
  } else {
    ai_feature  # don't modify if short
  }

  

  ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(path_value), y = ai_value)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = cut_width(path_value, 0.2))) +
    facet_wrap(~ layer) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    labs(
      #title = paste(ai_feature, "vs Pathologist-graded ", path_feature),
      x = paste("Pathologist-graded", path_feature),
      y = ai_feature_wrapped) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +  # Set size and font
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      #plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

   df <- df %>%

      path_value = as.character(path_value),  # avoid factor-to-NA conversion

    ai_feature_wrapped <- if (nchar(ai_feature) > 20) {
    if (grepl("\\(", ai_feature)) {
      sub("\\(", "\n(", ai_feature)
    } else if (grepl("-", ai_feature)) {
      sub("-", "\n-", ai_feature)
    } else {
      ai_feature  # don't modify if no good split point
    }
  } else {
    ai_feature  # don't modify if short
  }

  

  ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(path_value), y = ai_value)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = cut_width(path_value, 0.2))) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    labs(
      #title = paste(ai_feature, "vs Pathologist-graded ", path_feature),
      x = paste("Pathologist-graded", path_feature),
      y = ai_feature_wrapped) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +  # Set size and font
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      #plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}
```

### Process features to be compared by compartment and layer
```{r}

subset_name <- "grading_sample"

#Read in pathologist feature
majority_grades <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx/output/agreement//majority_grades.json") %>%
  rename(image_fragment_mucosa_name = name,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_junctional_gradient = villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_junctiona_gradient) 


#Parse pathologist features
long_1 <- majority_grades %>%
  select(image_fragment_mucosa_name, 
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_cellularity,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_cellularity,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_cellularity,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_cellularity,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_clustering,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_clustering,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_patchy_infiltration,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_patchy_infiltration, 
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_junctional_gradient,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_junctional_gradient,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_junctional_gradient,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_junctional_gradient) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
           cols = matches("^(villi|crypts)_"),
           names_to = c("layer", "compartment", "feature"),
           names_pattern = "^(villi|crypts)_(epithelium|lamina_propria)_(.*)$",
           values_to = "path_value")

#Handle size and homogeneity separately (not graded by layer/compartment)
long_2 <- majority_grades %>%
  select(image_fragment_mucosa_name,
         lymphocyte_size,
         lymphocyte_homogeneity) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -image_fragment_mucosa_name,
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "path_value"
  ) 

path <- bind_rows(long_1, long_2) %>%
  mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocytes_")) %>%
  mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocyte_")) %>%
  mutate(layer = case_when(layer == "villi" ~ "Villi",
                           layer == "crypts" ~ "Crypts",
                           TRUE ~ layer),
         compartment = case_when(compartment == "epithelium" ~ "Epithelium",
                                 compartment == "lamina_propria" ~ "Lamina propria",
                                 TRUE ~ compartment),
         feature = case_when(feature == "cellularity" ~ "Cellularity",
                             feature == "clustering" ~ "Clustering",
                             feature == "junctional_gradient" ~ "Junctional gradient",
                             feature == "patchy_infiltration" ~ "Patchy infiltration",
                             feature == "size" ~ "Size",
                             feature == "homogeneity" ~ "Monomorphism",
                             TRUE ~ feature
                             ))

#write_json(path, paste0(output_dir, "parsed_path.json"), pretty = TRUE)



ai  <- fromJSON(paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "previous_versions/unscaled_", subset_name, ".json")) %>%
  rename(ai_value = value) 

global_size <- fromJSON(paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "previous_versions/feature_summaries_unprocessed_grading_sample.json")) %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_mucosa_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(image_fragment_mucosa_name, mean_lymphocytes_measured_area_um2, sd_lymphocytes_measured_area_um2) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =  c("mean_lymphocytes_measured_area_um2", "sd_lymphocytes_measured_area_um2"),
               names_to = "feature",
               values_to = "ai_value") %>%
  mutate(layer = NA,
         compartment = NA,
         feature = case_when(feature == "mean_lymphocytes_measured_area_um2" ~ "Mean size (global)",
                             feature == "sd_lymphocytes_measured_area_um2" ~ "SD size (global)",
         TRUE ~ feature
         ))

ai <- bind_rows(ai, global_size)

#Compartment comparisons
#List comparisons
compartment_comparison_list <- list(
  Cellularity = c("Count", "Lymphocyte distance (mean)"),
  `Junctional gradient` = c("Junctional distance (median)")
)


#Merge pathologist and ai features

# Generate merged dataframe list for each comparison
compartment_comparisons <- list()

for (path_feat in names(compartment_comparison_list)) {
  for (ai_feat in compartment_comparison_list[[path_feat]]) {
    df <- ai %>%
      filter(feature == ai_feat) %>%
      inner_join(
        path %>% filter(feature == path_feat),
        by = c("image_fragment_mucosa_name", "layer", "compartment")
      ) %>%
      mutate(path_feature = path_feat, ai_feature = ai_feat)
    
    compartment_comparisons[[paste(path_feat, ai_feat, sep = " vs ")]] <- df
  }
}

# Create storage for test results
compartment_residuals <- data.frame()

# Loop over all merged comparisons
for (name in names(compartment_comparisons)) {
  df <- compartment_comparisons[[name]]
  
  # Group by layer and compartment
  split_df <- df %>% group_by(layer, compartment) %>% group_split()
  
  for (sub in split_df) {
    if (nrow(sub) < 5) next  # skip small groups
    
    layer_val <- unique(sub$layer)
    comp_val <- unique(sub$compartment)
    path_feature <- unique(sub$path_feature)
    ai_feature <- unique(sub$ai_feature)
    
    model <- tryCatch(lm(ai_value ~ path_value, data = sub), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (is.null(model)) next
    
    # Shapiro-Wilk test
    shapiro <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(residuals(model)), error = function(e) NULL)
    shapiro_p <- if (!is.null(shapiro)) shapiro$p.value else NA
    
    # Breusch-Pagan test
    bp <- tryCatch(bptest(model), error = function(e) NULL)
    bp_p <- if (!is.null(bp)) bp$p.value else NA
    
    # Store results
    compartment_residuals  <- compartment_residuals  %>%
      bind_rows(data.frame(
      comparison = name,
      layer = layer_val,
      compartment = comp_val,
      ai_feature = ai_feature,
      path_feature = path_feature,
      shapiro_w = if (!is.null(shapiro)) unname(shapiro$statistic) else NA,
      shapiro_p = shapiro_p,
      bp_stat = if (!is.null(bp)) unname(bp$statistic) else NA,
      bp_df = if (!is.null(bp)) unname(bp$parameter) else NA,
      bp_p = bp_p
      ))
    
    # QQ plot
    qq_title <- paste0("QQ Plot: ", ai_feature, " ~ ", path_feature,
                       "\nLayer: ", layer_val, ", Compartment: ", comp_val)
    
    qq <- ggplot(data.frame(resid = residuals(model)), aes(sample = resid)) +
      stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
      ggtitle(qq_title) +
      theme_bw()
    
    print(qq)  # You can wrap this in a pdf() to save all plots
  }
}

compartment_correlations <- data.frame()

for (name in names(compartment_comparisons)) {
  df <- compartment_comparisons[[name]]
  
  split_df <- df %>% group_by(layer, compartment) %>% group_split()
  
  for (sub in split_df) {
    if (nrow(sub) < 5) next
    
    layer_val <- unique(sub$layer)
    comp_val <- unique(sub$compartment)
    path_feature <- unique(sub$path_feature)
    ai_feature <- unique(sub$ai_feature)
    
    # Spearman correlation
    cor_test <- tryCatch(
      cor.test(sub$ai_value, sub$path_value, method = "spearman"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (!is.null(cor_test)) {
      compartment_correlations  <- compartment_correlations  %>%
        bind_rows(data.frame(
          comparison = name,
          layer = layer_val,
          compartment = comp_val,
          ai_feature = ai_feature,
          path_feature = path_feature,
          spearman_rho = cor_test$estimate,
          p_value = cor_test$p.value,
          method = cor_test$method
        ))
    }
  }
}




for (name in names(compartment_comparisons)) {
  df <- compartment_comparisons[[name]]
  
  path_feature <- unique(df$path_feature)
  ai_feature <- unique(df$ai_feature)
  
  # Generate plot with custom theme
  p <- plot_box_compartments(df, path_feature, ai_feature) 
  # Save to PNG
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_dir, gsub(" ", "_", name), ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 7,
    height = 2.6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

  Monomorphism = c("SD size (global)")
)


# Generate merged dataframe list for each comparison
morph_comparisons <- list()

for (path_feat in names(morph_comparison_list)) {
  for (ai_feat in morph_comparison_list[[path_feat]]) {
    df <- ai  %>%
      filter(feature == ai_feat) %>%
      inner_join(
        path %>% filter(feature == path_feat),
        by = c("image_fragment_mucosa_name")
      ) %>%
      mutate(path_feature = path_feat, ai_feature = ai_feat)
    
    morph_comparisons[[paste(path_feat, ai_feat, sep = " vs ")]] <- df
  }
}

# Create storage for test results
morph_residuals <- data.frame()

# Loop over all merged comparisons
for (name in names(morph_comparisons)) {
  df <- morph_comparisons[[name]]
  
  path_feature <- unique(df$path_feature)
  ai_feature <- unique(df$ai_feature)
  
  model <- tryCatch(lm(ai_value ~ path_value, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(model)) next
    
  # Shapiro-Wilk test
  shapiro <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(residuals(model)), error = function(e) NULL)
  shapiro_p <- if (!is.null(shapiro)) shapiro$p.value else NA
  
  # Breusch-Pagan test
  bp <- tryCatch(bptest(model), error = function(e) NULL)
  bp_p <- if (!is.null(bp)) bp$p.value else NA
    
  # Store results
  morph_residuals  <- morph_residuals  %>%
    bind_rows(data.frame(
    comparison = name,
    ai_feature = ai_feature,
    path_feature = path_feature,
    shapiro_w = if (!is.null(shapiro)) unname(shapiro$statistic) else NA,
    shapiro_p = shapiro_p,
    bp_stat = if (!is.null(bp)) unname(bp$statistic) else NA,
    bp_df = if (!is.null(bp)) unname(bp$parameter) else NA,
    bp_p = bp_p
    ))
    
    # QQ plot
  qq_title <- paste0("QQ Plot: ", ai_feature, " ~ ", path_feature)
  
  qq <- ggplot(data.frame(resid = residuals(model)), aes(sample = resid)) +
    stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
    ggtitle(qq_title) +
    theme_bw()
    
    print(qq) 
}



morph_correlations <- data.frame()

for (name in names(morph_comparisons)) {
  df <- morph_comparisons[[name]]
  


  path_feature <- unique(df$path_feature)
  ai_feature <- unique(df$ai_feature)
    
    # Spearman correlation
  cor_test <- tryCatch(
    cor.test(df$ai_value, df$path_value, method = "spearman"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
    
  if (!is.null(cor_test)) {
    morph_correlations  <- morph_correlations  %>%
      bind_rows(data.frame(
        comparison = name,
        ai_feature = ai_feature,
        path_feature = path_feature,
        spearman_rho = cor_test$estimate,
        p_value = cor_test$p.value,
        method = cor_test$method
      ))
  }
}

for (name in names(morph_comparisons)) {
  df <- morph_comparisons[[name]]
  
  path_feature <- unique(df$path_feature)
  ai_feature <- unique(df$ai_feature)
  
  # Generate plot with custom theme
  p <- plot_box_morph(df, path_feature, ai_feature) 
  # Save to PNG
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_dir, gsub(" ", "_", name), ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 3.5,
    height = 1.75,
    dpi = 300
  )
}


correlation <- bind_rows(compartment_correlations, lp_correlations, epi_correlations, morph_correlations)

write_json(correlation, paste0(output_dir, "correlation.json"), pretty = TRUE)

residuals_and_correlations <- bind_rows(compartment_residuals, lp_residuals, epi_residuals, morph_residuals) %>%
  left_join(correlation)

feature_order <- c("Count", 
                   "Lymphocyte distance (mean)", 
                   "Lymphocyte distance (sd)", 
                   "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio", 
                   "Mean size (global)",
                   "SD size (global)",
                   "% in clusters" ,
                   "Junctional distance (median)")  
layer_order <- c("Villi", "Crypts")
compartment_order <- c("Lamina propria", "Epithelium")
ass_order <- c("Cellularity", "Clustering", "Patchy infiltration", "Size", "Monomorphism", "Junctional gradient")


correlation_for_paper <- residuals_and_correlations %>%
  mutate(
    shapiro_w = round(shapiro_w, 2),
    shapiro_p = case_when(
      is.na(shapiro_p) ~ NA_character_,
      shapiro_p < 0.0001 ~ "p<.0001",
      shapiro_p < 0.001  ~ "p<.001",
      shapiro_p < 0.01 ~ paste0("p = ", sub("^0\\.", ".", format(round(shapiro_p, 3), nsmall = 3))),
      TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", sub("^0\\.", ".", format(round(shapiro_p, 2), nsmall = 2)))),
      bp_stat = round(bp_stat, 2),
      bp_p = case_when(
           is.na(bp_p) ~ NA_character_,
           bp_p < 0.0001 ~ "p<.0001",
           bp_p < 0.001 ~ "p<.001",
           bp_p < 0.01 ~ paste0("p = ", sub("^0\\.", ".", format(round(bp_p, 3), nsmall = 3))),
           TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", sub("^0\\.", ".", format(round(bp_p, 2), nsmall = 2)))),
      spearman_rho = round(spearman_rho, 2),
      spearman_p = case_when(
           is.na(p_value) ~ NA_character_,
           p_value < 0.0001 ~ "p<.0001",
           p_value < 0.001 ~ "p<.001",
           p_value < 0.01 ~ paste0("p = ", sub("^0\\.", ".", format(round(p_value, 3), nsmall = 3))),
           TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", sub("^0\\.", ".", format(round(p_value, 2), nsmall = 2))))) %>%
  mutate(shapiro = paste0(shapiro_w, " (",shapiro_p, ")"),
         bp = paste0(bp_stat, " (",bp_p, ")"),
         spearman = paste0(spearman_rho, " (",spearman_p,")")) %>%
  select(layer, compartment, path_feature, ai_feature, shapiro, bp, spearman) %>%
  arrange(desc(layer),
          compartment,
          path_feature) %>%
  rename(Layer = layer,
         Compartment = compartment,
         Feature = ai_feature,
         `Pathologist assessment` = path_feature,
         `Shapiro-Wilk\n(W, p)` = shapiro,
         `Breusch-Pagan\n(statistic, p)` = bp,
         `Spearman\n(rho, p)` = spearman) %>%
  mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels = feature_order),
         Layer = factor(Layer, levels = layer_order),
         Compartment = factor(Compartment, levels = compartment_order),
         `Pathologist assessment` = factor(`Pathologist assessment`, levels = ass_order)) %>%
  arrange(Feature, `Pathologist assessment`, Compartment, Layer) %>%
  select(Feature, `Pathologist assessment`, Layer, Compartment, `Shapiro-Wilk\n(W, p)`, `Breusch-Pagan\n(statistic, p)`, `Spearman\n(rho, p)`)

```


### Correlation plot

```{r}
corr <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "correlation.json"))

cor_avg <- corr %>%
  group_by(ai_feature, path_feature) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rho = mean(spearman_rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate("Pathologist grade" = case_when(path_feature == "Clustering" ~ "Intraepithelial clustering",
                                         path_feature == "Patchy infiltration" ~ "Lamina propria patchy distribution",
                                         TRUE ~ path_feature),
         "Quantitative feature" = case_when(ai_feature == "% in clusters" ~ "% in Clust",
                                            ai_feature == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio"~ "Epi:LP",
                                            ai_feature == "Junctional distance (median)"~ "Junct Dist",
                                            ai_feature == "Lymphocyte distance (mean)"~ "Mean Dist",
                                            ai_feature == "Lymphocyte distance (sd)"~ "SD Dist",
                                            ai_feature == "Mean size (global)"~ "Mean Size",
                                            ai_feature == "SD size (global)"~ "SD Size",
                                            TRUE ~ ai_feature)
         )

cor_avg <- cor_avg %>%
  mutate(
    rho_cat = case_when(
      mean_rho >=  0.50              ~ "strong_pos",
      mean_rho >=  0.30              ~ "moderate_pos",
      mean_rho >=  0.10              ~ "weak_pos",
      mean_rho >  -0.10 & mean_rho < 0.10 ~ "near_zero",
      mean_rho <= -0.50              ~ "strong_neg",
      mean_rho <= -0.30              ~ "moderate_neg",
      mean_rho <= -0.10              ~ "weak_neg",
      TRUE                           ~ NA_character_
    ),
    rho_cat = factor(
      rho_cat,
      levels = c(
        "strong_neg", "moderate_neg", "weak_neg",
        "near_zero",
        "weak_pos", "moderate_pos", "strong_pos"
      )
    )
  )



cor_avg$`Pathologist grade` <- factor(
  cor_avg$`Pathologist grade`,
  levels = c(
    "Cellularity",
    "Intraepithelial clustering",
    "Lamina propria patchy distribution",
    "Junctional gradient",
    "Size",
    "Monomorphism"
  )
)

cor_avg$`Quantitative feature` <- factor(
  cor_avg$`Quantitative feature`,
  levels = c(
    "Count",
    "Mean Dist",
    "SD Dist",
    "Epi:LP",
    "% in Clust",
    "Junct Dist",
    "Mean Size",
    "SD Size"
  )
)

ggplot(cor_avg, aes(x = `Quantitative feature`, y = `Pathologist grade`, fill = rho_cat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # optional: show the numeric mean_rho inside each tile
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_rho)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Spearman ρ",
    values = c(
      strong_neg   = "darkorange3",   # dark orange
      moderate_neg = "orange2",       # mid orange
      weak_neg     = "moccasin",      # light orange
      near_zero    = "grey80",        # grey
      weak_pos     = "lightblue",     # light blue
      moderate_pos = "deepskyblue3",  # mid blue
      strong_pos   = "navy"           # dark blue
    ),
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c(
      strong_neg   = "≤ -0.50",
      moderate_neg = "-0.49 to -0.30",
      weak_neg     = "-0.29 to -0.10",
      near_zero    = "-0.09 to 0.09",
      weak_pos     = "0.10 to 0.29",
      moderate_pos = "0.30 to 0.49",
      strong_pos   = "≥ 0.50"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +  # optional: flip y order to look like a table
  labs(
    x = "AI-Derived Feature",
    y = "Pathologist-Graded Feature"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
```
